parts.text: Generate and filter synthetic 3D motion samples to study whether physically plausible training data improve full-body motion generation from first-person observations.

Six-month M2 internship, from February 2027. Selection begins on 1 December 2026. The call gives 31 December as a flexible deadline and reviews candidates as they apply. Send the requested documents to the recruitment contact under the subject Internship-PGG-TSP.
